study_note: Ordinary direct-state native SAC on DMControl Humanoid Walk using the published TD-MPC Table-5 numerical optimizer, replay, network-width, and update-schedule hyperparameters that are expressible in this repository. This is not a byte-for-byte Yarats SAC reproduction: the local learner consumes the 67-value state directly rather than implementing Table 5's latent-100 encoder and retains its established SB3-like critic-loss, alpha-loss, log-standard-deviation, initialization, and update-order semantics. Seven million agent decisions at action repeat 2 equal the published 14 million raw simulator steps. The three seeds are separate W&B runs in one group. Deterministic ten-episode evaluations run at step zero and every 50k agent decisions (100k raw steps); this evaluation cadence is an operational comparator protocol, not a Table-5 training hyperparameter. Model checkpoints and trajectory logs are disabled; W&B stages on node-local storage, leaving only tiny evaluation CSVs and Slurm output in Hydra home storage.
